book.name: 1 Akakolintu
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Akakolintu

content: Ungengame nenga ngita nenga chininkengama Kilichitu.
Kupuka muto pumunyinamii Chapanga
Ninumbalila nhwalo minngomboka kwa kila kilebhe na kughakamula malaghalikilo ghunipekii.
Nambo nipala kabhele mmanye kubhehe Kilichitu ndi muto gwa kila munalome, na munalome ndi muto gwa nhwana mundo, Chapanga ndi muto gwa Kilichitu.
Bhahe, kila munalome jwannyinamila Chapanga amu jwatangacha lilobhe lya Chapanga kongo apukite muto gwake jwampela hone Kilichitu.
Na mwikeghe jhojhoha pannyinamii Chapanga amu kutangacha malobhe gha Chapanga changapuka muto gwake, ampela hone munalome jwake, jwatehila naha tela tugha na mwikeghe jwachekwile majhunjo umuto.
Mwikeghe jwangapukita muto gwake, mbaha achekule majhunjo ghake. Nambo anda ibhii hone kwa mwikeghe kuchekula amu kupungucha majhunjo ghake, bhahe, mbaha apuke muto gwake.
Munalome yamaha jhe kupuka muto gwake, nhwalo jwenio ndi nnandanikiho gwa Chapanga na ung'alicho gwake Chapanga. Nambo mwikeghe ndi ung'alicho gwa munalome.
Munalome apitii jhe kwa mwikeghe, nambo mwikeghe apitii kwa munalome.
Munalome apanginwe jhe kwa nhwalo gwa mwikeghe, nambo mwikeghe apanganiwe kwa nhwalo gwa munalome.
Ndi nhwalo mwikeghe ipuka muto gwake kubhehe ukindendeke ghubhii panane jhake na kwa akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga.
Helahela, palonge jha Bhambo mwikeghe akihobholela ndeka changa munalome, na jwenio munalome akihobholela ndeka changa mwikeghe.
Anda hela mwikeghe chapitila kwa munalome, helahela munalome abhelwike na mwikeghe, nambo kila kilebhe kihuma kwa Chapanga.
Nnyomole mabhene, bho, chambone mwikeghe kunnyinamii Chapanga kongo apukite jhe kilebhe chochoha umuto gwake?
Chapanga papangina ilangii hotu munalome kubhehe na majhunjo mandandamaho ndi hone jhake,
nambo kwa mwikeghe anda abhii na majhunjo mandandamaho, chenie ndi kilebhe chamaha kwa jwenio. Nhwalo apekilwe majhunjo mandandamaho ghampuke.
Mundo anda ipala kutaungana pakate jha lijhambu lende, twenga tukwete jhe ghutuyobhalile ghange, hilu bhando bha Chapanga bhubhahobhalile Kilichitu bhakwete jhe ghabhayobhalila ghange.
Chakulyegha cha Bhambo
Mu malaghalikilo ghanga ghughahika ninombangana jhe, nhwalo mu makonganiko ghino gha kunnyinamii Chapanga mughatenda ghanganandela kuliku ghambone.
Pukutumbulila, pumukonganika pamonga upitii mpechangano pakate jhino, na nenga pandina nilipala lijhambu lende.
Ipalwa pabhehe na mpechangano pakate jhino, kupala bhala bhibhanyeketela Chapanga bhamanyikane.
Pumukonganika pamonga, mihola miilye chakulya cha kunkomboka Bhambo kone nahi jhe!
Nhwalo pakulyegha, kila mundo alyegha changa lendelela bhange, ade bhange bhabhehe na njala kone bhange bhalobhile!

Bho, mihoto jhe kulye na kunywegha kajha kwino? Amu bho, mwapechelecha bhando bha Chapanga bhubhanyeketii Kilichitu na kwapeke hone bhene bhanga kilebhe? Ngohe ninobholele nike? Bho, ninombe? Ng'oo! Ninomba jhe kwa lijhambu lende.
Nhwalo nenga mbokii kuhumii kwa Bhambo malaghalikilo ghunimpekii, Bhambo Yecho pajhambilwa uhiko ghola, ajhakutola libumunda,
pajhomolila kunchenguu Chapanga, ajhakumetula, ajhakulonge, “Jhenjeno ndi yegha jhango jhunibhoha kwa nhwalo gwino mangota, ntende naha kwa kungomboka nenga.”
Helahela pubhajhomolila kulyegha, ajhakutola kibaba, ajhakulonge: “Chenjeno ndi kibaba cha lilaghano liyono lya miyahe jhango. Ntende naha kila pumunywegha kwa kungomboka nenga.”
Nhwalo kila mukulyegha libumunda na kunywela kibaba chenje, mutangacha kuwe kwa Bhambo, ade papalakuhika kabhele.
Yene, mundo jhojhoha jwalyegha libumunda hele amu kuinywela kibaba jha Bhambo changatopela, jwenio chabhehe atei uhakaho kwa yegha na miyahe jha Bhambo.
Bhahe, kila mundo akilolekiye jwenio, peniya ndi ahoto kulyegha libumunda lende na kunywela kibaba chenie.
Nhwalo mundo jhojhoha jwalyegha na kunywegha abhehe na uchakaka ndi yegha jha Bhambo, changatenda yenio akiletela luhadabulo jwenio.
Ndi mana bhando bhamahele pakate jhino bhaleghelike na bhange bhilwalwa, na bhange bhajhomwike.
Anda tukihingukiye mbone, ngatuhadabwilwe jhe na Chapanga.
Nambo putuhadabulwa na Bhambo, tubholwa kutama mbone, tukoto kuhadabulwa pamonga na bhando bhangaumanya Chapanga pannema.
Kwa ghanga, makalongo bhango, pumukukonganika kulye chakulya cha Bhambo, kila jhumo annendelela nnyake.
Mundo anda abhii na njala, alya kajhake, pumukonganika nkotoka kuhadabulwa na Chapanga. Nambo ghange, chinimmola pumbalakuhika.
